title: Geometric Continuum, Hypercontinuum, and Ultracontinuum
deck:
The chapter develops the hierarchy through which Compalphas form
            Geometric Continuums, Hypercontinuums, and the Geometric
            Ultracontinuum.

concise.body:
Chapter

This chapter seeks to demonstrate that the structure and functionality of Apparent Reality are formed by what, in TUIDG, is termed the Geometric Hypercontinuum (GHC).

It further seeks to demonstrate that the Geometric Hypercontinuum is a structure constituted by another relatively simpler structure called the Geometric Continuum (GC), which, in turn, is formed by an infinity of types of immaterial geometric circles.

Alpha Components (Compalphas): The Constituents of the Geometric Continuum

What grants the universe the apparent material reality we perceive?

The Rotating Interaction is the geometric mechanism that establishes an apparent rotational motion for the Interaction Circles that constitute the Compalphas.

The Compalphas are the "basic" dimensionless, immaterial, functional geometric units forming Merons, and these, in turn, form absolutely all constituent substances of all bodies in the universe.

Merons are formed by the intersection of groups of 12 Compalphas, linked by Compalpha Triads (which are common to these groups) and organized in a Cuboctahedral shape, such that each Compalpha is interconnected with 6 others. The Compalphas are interconnected continuously; each of the infinite Compalphas is linked to 6 others, and each of those to 6 more via their Interaction Circles through the mechanism of the Rotating Interaction, connecting to all infinite Compalphas and forming a dimensionless Geometric Continuum.

The Interaction Circles, the Compalphas, the Merons, and the Geometric Continuum are dimensionless structures because they are formed by immaterial geometric elements that exist only apparently within the infinite dimension of Absolute Empty Space.

The Compalpha, the Fundamental Geometric Element

Of the infinite forms of existing geometric elements, only four types are necessary and sufficient for the formation of the Compalphas, which are the generators of the infinite patterns of this apparent universal physical reality as we perceive it.

And because the Compalpha is a Fundamental Component, being the smallest part of the composition of one of the infinite Apparent Realities, it receives a name composed of the first letter of the Greek alphabet, the letter Alpha — thus, Alpha Component, or Compalpha.

The Compalphas interact through two geometric mechanisms, which are the Rotating Interaction and the Cyclic Interaction, forming a continuous geometric structure characterized by having infinite Structural Dimensions and a single Absolute Dimension called the Geometric Continuum.

Figure 3.3 – The Alpha Component or Compalpha**

The figure above shows two aspects of the Compalpha, displaying only 4 of its 6 types of Interaction Circles.

Looking at the structure of a Geometric Continuum, we can see that it is formed by an infinity of points (and axes and planes) and circles that are duly organized in a three-directional (3D) form in Absolute Empty Space, forming the Compalphas.

Thus we have the Alpha Point, which is the common point of tangency of the four types of Alpha Circles, or Interaction Circles; we have the Alpha Axis, which is a vector indicating the direction of rotation of the Interaction Circles from the Alpha Point, and the angle of relative positioning between the Compalphas in the Meronic structure.

- Meronic Circles – Cm (blue), with an arbitrary diameter equal to 1

- Intrameronic Circles – Im (white), with a diameter of ~0,464 that of the Cms

- Molecular Circles – Cmo (red), with a diameter of 48

- Intramolecular Circles – CIm (yellow), with a diameter of ~22,27

- Intraexomolecular Circles – CIem with a 89,11

- Exomolecular Circles – CEm, with a 192 Cms to diameters extending to infinity

Animation 3.4 – The Mechanism of the Rotating Interaction of the Compalphas**

The appearance of the Compalpha is as seen in Image 3.3 above; however, it is always very difficult to describe it verbally or mathematically, since there does not exist, in classical literature, a geometric structure with these functional characteristics. Thus, we can say that each Alpha Point of each Compalpha is linked to six other Alpha Points, belonging to six other Compalphas, at angles of 120 degrees, measured on the Alpha Plane (the median plane of this element) — three below at 120 degrees, and three above, also at 120 degrees, but in relation to the Alpha Axis.

Figure 3.5 – The Metalpha Meron, the Cell of the Geometric Continuum

The Geometric Continuums and Apparent Reality

The Geometric Continuum of TUIDG is not the same thing as the Luminiferous Ether that permeated the imagination of classical physicists, for the Ether would be something without defined structure and constituted by something completely different from the corpuscular substantiality of the universe; it would not be made of the same matter or energy that composed the universe, it would be merely a medium responsible for the transmissibility of radiant energy through the vacuum of space, although the idea that forms in our mind, given its exceptional characteristics, is that of something that would have the same properties as air or water.

Whereas the Geometric Continuum and the Apparent Matter of TUIDG are constituted by the same types of elements — that is, by immaterial geometric elements — they are the very Apparent Substantiality of the universe.

Figure 3.6 – Simplified Aspect of the Structure of the Interaction Circles of the Compalphas Forming the Geometric Continuum

The Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG), the Apparent Reality

According to the propositions of TUIDG, we have seen that from the standpoint of an absolutely immaterial, mathematical, axiomatic, logical geometry, there may exist infinite Structural Dimensions of Geometric Continuums (GC); therefore, there may exist infinite geometric structures, infinitely extensive and voluminous, superimposed within the same Absolute Empty and dimensionless Space that is the universe in which we "live" and of which we are part.

Animation 3.6.1 – Simplification of a Superposition of Only 6 Geometric Continuums Forming a Geometric Hypercontinuum

However, according to the same geometric propositions, a single arbitrary Structural Dimension of a Geometric Continuum, among the infinite ones that exist, without an infinite Geometric Superposition, cannot form a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG).

What must be understood is that any Structural Dimension of a Geometric Continuum may have the points (the vertices of the polygons) of its structure superimposed in infinite spatial positions, thus generating an infinite geometric density in each particular dimension within Absolute Empty Space, here called the Omega Dimension.

In the structure of a single Geometric Hypercontinuum with any Structural Dimension, or in an Apparent Reality of any dimensional base, all bodies — from the Compalphas, through planets, stars, and galaxies, to the structure of the universe as a whole — possess infinite "copies" of themselves, identical or progressively different, located in infinite positions.

In very simple terms, we may say that a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) is merely a Geometric Continuum (GC) of any dimension, revolved about infinite axes of rotation.

Presentation 3.8 – Aspect of the Superposition of Geometric Continuums (GC) Forming a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG)

By having infinite geometric density, a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) allows a Compalpha, a Meron, or a molecule — and hence anything formed by them — to have an exact "copy" of itself disposed in infinite positions along any direction of its own structure.

Thus, it is this property of superposition possessed by the Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) — that of allowing any geometric element (the Compalphas) to be "drawn" in infinite positions in space — that generates Apparent Movement in the elements of its structure.

The Geometric Ultracontinuum and the Infinite Apparent Universes

What is a Geometric Ultracontinuum and how does it differ from the Geometric Hypercontinuum?

According to the propositions of TUIDG, a Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG) is an immaterial structure constituted by the superposition of infinite Geometric Hypercontinuums (HCG) with infinite distinct Structural Dimensions, whereas a Geometric Hypercontinuum is an immaterial structure constituted by the infinite superposition of the infinite Compalphas of a single Structural Dimension.

The immaterial structure of a Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG) allows the infinite Apparent Realities (or universes) provided by the Geometric Hypercontinuums to exist in infinite Structural Dimensions, while the immaterial structure of a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) only allows for the existence of infinite Apparent Realities structured from a single Structural Dimension of Compalphas — an arbitrary dimension relative to any other arbitrary dimension.

In fact, by the logic of possibilities, the Geometric Ultracontinuum is the final structure, for what differentiates one type of Geometric Continuum (GC) from another is not simply the Structural Dimension of its basic elements, which are the Compalphas, but the superposition of its Structural Dimension, of the rotation and of the spatial position of these basic elements.

According to TUIDG, the Apparent Reality of the universe is produced by a hierarchy of dimensionless immaterial geometric elements that first form the Geometric Continuums (GC), which in turn form the Geometric Hypercontinuums (HCG), which finally form the Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG).

Chapter

This chapter seeks to demonstrate that the structure and functionality of Apparent Reality are formed by what, in TUIDG, is termed the Geometric Hypercontinuum (GHC). This structure is, in physical terms, what we understand to be space, matter, energy, and time itself; in this theory, "energy" and "time" are merely the products of the Apparent Motion performed by Apparent Matter, which exists only as "immaterial designs" within this same Geometric Hypercontinuum.

It further seeks to demonstrate that the Geometric Hypercontinuum is a structure constituted by another relatively simpler structure called the Geometric Continuum (GC), which, in turn, is formed by an infinity of types of immaterial geometric circles. These form an infinity of structures with toroidal shapes, termed Alpha Components or Compalphas, which are the constituents of all Merons (atoms)—that is, the shapers of what we properly understand to be the "material reality" of the universe.

Alpha Components (Compalphas): The Constituents of the Geometric Continuum

What grants the universe the apparent material reality we perceive? Is there truly a real, corpuscular basis of structurally impenetrable dimensions—such as that constituted by the supposed "fundamental particles" (and antiparticles) established by the Standard Cosmological Model (SCM) of conventional physics, dissolved within a space that expands and contracts and which, for brief moments, is capable of creating or annihilating them? What causes absolutely all constituent elements of the universe to interact mutually to form the whole? What functional mechanisms lie behind what we assume to be a Material Reality?

Physicists establish and quantify the relations between natural phenomena with great precision through what they call "physical laws." However, they remain unable to state with absolute certainty how these laws truly process at their fundamental levels. Physicists still do not know what the "fundamental" truly is; what science can and indeed does accomplish with its methodology is merely to quantify that which the "eyes" can see.

According to the propositions of TUIDG, there is no universal physical reality formed by the existence of supposed material "fundamental particles" at the base of everything. This reality we perceive is fundamentally due to the Geometric Interactions of the Alpha Components, or Compalphas, which are absolutely immaterial. Through the strictly logical processes of the Rotating Interaction and the Cyclic Interaction performed by them, they are capable of generating this Apparent Reality.

The supposed "material reality" of the universe cannot exist due to the Axiomatic Principle of Void-Matter Indistinction (which establishes the impossibility of differentiation between Absolute Empty Space and supposed substance), the Axiomatic Principle of Necessarily Indefinite Fragmentation (which establishes the infinite divisibility of anything that might exist), and the Axiomatic Principle of Logical-Constructive Interactive Incapability (which establishes the impossibility of interaction between any two elements without a third directly connected to the first two, acting as a single structure).

Despite this set of fundamental logical constraints—which impede real theoretical development in conventional physics—we are still presented with the absurd descriptions of "strong," "weak," "electromagnetic," and "gravitational" interactions found in quantum and relativistic physics, which are fundamentally contrary to the idea of a necessary continuity between these universal structures.

In TUIDG, supposed material reality is, in truth, merely an Apparent Reality formed by immaterial and dimensionless geometric elements—that is, elements without substantiality and without defined size—in the form of toroids represented by Interaction Circles. Through the mechanism of the Rotating Interaction, these constitute the Alpha Components (Compalphas). Therefore, this supposed material reality is nothing more than an Apparent Reality, as its constituent elements are merely immaterial geometric entities.

The Rotating Interaction is the geometric mechanism that establishes an apparent rotational motion for the Interaction Circles that constitute the Compalphas. This interaction is responsible for the properties of attraction and repulsion between Compalphas—the "positive and negative" aspect of "matter"—and is the shaper of all Merons, while its "break" is responsible for Meronic deconstruction. The breakdown of the Rotating Interaction mechanism occurs when the oscillation angles of the Compalpha axes are greater than 60°, with an angular opening of 120°, as this involves an oscillation around a fixed point. In physical terms, this is equivalent to the weak force that dissociates "atomic nuclei," but without the need to introduce a set of other "fundamental particles" such as $W^+$, $W^-$, and $Z^0$ bosons.

The Compalphas are the "basic" dimensionless, immaterial, functional geometric units forming Merons, and these, in turn, form absolutely all constituent substances of all bodies in the universe. The term "basic" is inappropriate, for there is no "absolute fundamental structural dimension," since any of the infinite dimensions of geometric elements can serve as the "base" for the formation of subsequent structures.

Merons are formed by the intersection of groups of 12 Compalphas, linked by Compalpha Triads (which are common to these groups) and organized in a Cuboctahedral shape, such that each Compalpha is interconnected with 6 others. The Compalphas are interconnected continuously; each of the infinite Compalphas is linked to 6 others, and each of those to 6 more via their Interaction Circles through the mechanism of the Rotating Interaction, connecting to all infinite Compalphas and forming a dimensionless Geometric Continuum.

The Interaction Circles, the Compalphas, the Merons, and the Geometric Continuum are dimensionless structures because they are formed by immaterial geometric elements that exist only apparently within the infinite dimension of Absolute Empty Space. Therefore, they can possess infinite dimensions; they do not need a specific dimension or a predetermined base to form all subsequent structures.

The Compalpha, the Fundamental Geometric Element

Of the infinite forms of existing geometric elements, only four types are necessary and sufficient for the formation of the Compalphas, which are the generators of the infinite patterns of this apparent universal physical reality as we perceive it. The elements that constitute it are: the point, the straight line, the plane, and the circle, of an immaterial geometry.

And because the Compalpha is a Fundamental Component, being the smallest part of the composition of one of the infinite Apparent Realities, it receives a name composed of the first letter of the Greek alphabet, the letter Alpha — thus, Alpha Component, or Compalpha. It may be defined as a fundamental functional geometric component, with infinite "micro" and "macro" dimensions; that is, it does not possess a defined "size," as do the supposed "particles" of physics, for from any arbitrary "size" it is capable of constituting the same type of geometric structure whose functionality constitutes an Apparent Reality.

Therefore, a Planck length and a Planck time make no sense whatsoever, for in a dimensionless universe there is no reason to believe that an element could exist that is the "smallest of all," a solid and real element that is insurmountable and indivisible. For on a relative scale of structural dimensions we cannot have an element that is the "largest of all," since that element would necessarily be contained by something larger than itself; therefore, logically, we cannot have an element that is the "smallest of all."

The Compalphas interact through two geometric mechanisms, which are the Rotating Interaction and the Cyclic Interaction, forming a continuous geometric structure characterized by having infinite Structural Dimensions and a single Absolute Dimension called the Geometric Continuum.

Figure 3.3 – The Alpha Component or Compalpha**

The figure above shows two aspects of the Compalpha, displaying only 4 of its 6 types of Interaction Circles. The animation below shows the relationship between distance and the manner in which two Compalphas interact in space, through the Interaction Circles, to progressively form Triads, Cuboctahedrons (or Metalphas), and all types of Merons.

Looking at the structure of a Geometric Continuum, we can see that it is formed by an infinity of points (and axes and planes) and circles that are duly organized in a three-directional (3D) form in Absolute Empty Space, forming the Compalphas.

Thus we have the Alpha Point, which is the common point of tangency of the four types of Alpha Circles, or Interaction Circles; we have the Alpha Axis, which is a vector indicating the direction of rotation of the Interaction Circles from the Alpha Point, and the angle of relative positioning between the Compalphas in the Meronic structure. The six (6) types of Interaction Circles (intrinsic magnetic fields or toroidal fields) receive special names according to the interactive process they enable.

Accordingly, the Interaction Circles constituting the Compalpha are called:

- Meronic Circles – Cm (blue), with an arbitrary diameter equal to 1

- Intrameronic Circles – Im (white), with a diameter of ~0,464 that of the Cms

- Molecular Circles – Cmo (red), with a diameter of 48

- Intramolecular Circles – CIm (yellow), with a diameter of ~22,27

- Intraexomolecular Circles – CIem with a 89,11

- Exomolecular Circles – CEm, with a 192 Cms to diameters extending to infinity

We shall see, later on, a detailed description of their functions in the interactive processes between the Compalphas.

Animation 3.4 – The Mechanism of the Rotating Interaction of the Compalphas**

The appearance of the Compalpha is as seen in Image 3.3 above; however, it is always very difficult to describe it verbally or mathematically, since there does not exist, in classical literature, a geometric structure with these functional characteristics. Thus, we can say that each Alpha Point of each Compalpha is linked to six other Alpha Points, belonging to six other Compalphas, at angles of 120 degrees, measured on the Alpha Plane (the median plane of this element) — three below at 120 degrees, and three above, also at 120 degrees, but in relation to the Alpha Axis.

The mode of connection between them is through each of the three Meronic Circles of each Alpha Point, which is in contact with seven others of the same type, forming a set of eight Interaction Circles. As this sequence of connections is infinite, sets of twelve Alpha Points are formed which, when joined by straight lines, form the geometric solid known as the cuboctahedron, here called the Metacube. If we were to ask what its "mass" is, we would find the value twelve, since it is formed by twelve Compalphas; however, in relation to the "mass" of the other types of Merons, which are formed by it, its mass ratio is equivalent to one.

Both the metacubic forms and the circular forms can represent the structure of the Geometric Continuum, the former being easier to visualize. In the figure below we have the structure formed by the twelve Alpha Points and their four types of Interaction Circles, forming the Metacube Meron, or Metalpha. This geometric structure can be understood as the Cell of the Geometric Continuum. As we can see in the image below (Fig. 3.6), this Metalpha Meron can be represented in its simplified form, without all the Interaction Circles, merely in its metacubic form.

Figure 3.5 – The Metalpha Meron, the Cell of the Geometric Continuum

According to the propositions of TUIDG (TUIDG), the supposed universal physical reality is nothing more than an appearance, due to the fact that there can exist an infinite capacity for interaction among these types of immaterial and dimensionless geometric elements, organized in such a way as to produce a functionally logical and continuously interconnected geometric structure. A structure formed by elements that are "made" of nothing, without minimum or maximum structural dimension, but which possess the functionalities of the Spinning Interaction and the Cyclic Interaction, through which all the functional patterns that we understand as space, matter, and movement (energy) are generated.

Put in practical terms, the supposed physical reality is not formed by elements with insurmountable dimensions as if they were images produced by "pixels" of limited structure, such as those of a computer monitor or a television set, for such "limited pixels" do not exist. What happens is that each "pixel" of a reality is, in fact, constituted by other "pixels," and these by others, and so on, in an indefinite process.

According to TUIDG, determinations such as being, matter, energy, and substance cannot exist, for from nothing, no absolutely real thing can arise, no matter how much infinite time there might be. Thus, only Absolute Emptiness, which has infinite dimension and is here called the Omega Dimension, is what exists.

It is in this Omega Dimension that the infinite Compalphas, united in groups of twelve by their Interaction Circles, through the principle of the Rotating Interaction, which establishes an apparent rotation of their Interaction Circles, form the cuboctahedral structures called Metalphas or Metacubes, which are interconnected in the form of an infinite crystalline lattice called the Geometric Continuum. The Compalpha, being a geometric element present in the void, an element that does not differ from nothingness itself, is nothing more than subjectivity of subjectivity — an element constituted by points of geometry without materiality, as an Immaterial element.

The Geometric Continuums and Apparent Reality

The Geometric Continuum of TUIDG is not the same thing as the Luminiferous Ether that permeated the imagination of classical physicists, for the Ether would be something without defined structure and constituted by something completely different from the corpuscular substantiality of the universe; it would not be made of the same matter or energy that composed the universe, it would be merely a medium responsible for the transmissibility of radiant energy through the vacuum of space, although the idea that forms in our mind, given its exceptional characteristics, is that of something that would have the same properties as air or water.

Whereas the Geometric Continuum and the Apparent Matter of TUIDG are constituted by the same types of elements — that is, by immaterial geometric elements — they are the very Apparent Substantiality of the universe. There does not exist a substance formed by one "thing" and a Geometric Continuum formed by another "thing"; rather, both are the same "thing." The Structural Dimension of this Geometric Continuum is a function of the dimensions of the Compalphas themselves, which may be numerically infinite; that is, its basic unit, being merely a geometric form, may have any dimension, since it is contained within a space of infinite dimension. Its Absolute Dimension, however, depends solely and exclusively upon the infinite dimension of absolute Space (Absolute Emptiness), here called the Omega Dimension.

Figure 3.6 – Simplified Aspect of the Structure of the Interaction Circles of the Compalphas Forming the Geometric Continuum

The Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG), the Apparent Reality

According to the propositions of TUIDG, we have seen that from the standpoint of an absolutely immaterial, mathematical, axiomatic, logical geometry, there may exist infinite Structural Dimensions of Geometric Continuums (GC); therefore, there may exist infinite geometric structures, infinitely extensive and voluminous, superimposed within the same Absolute Empty and dimensionless Space that is the universe in which we "live" and of which we are part.

Animation 3.6.1 – Simplification of a Superposition of Only 6 Geometric Continuums Forming a Geometric Hypercontinuum

However, according to the same geometric propositions, a single arbitrary Structural Dimension of a Geometric Continuum, among the infinite ones that exist, without an infinite Geometric Superposition, cannot form a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG). This is not only because they exist in Infinite Structural Dimensions, but because each of these Infinite Structural Dimensions may have infinite "copies" superimposed, all coexisting in Infinite Spatial Positions within Absolute Emptiness.

What must be understood is that any Structural Dimension of a Geometric Continuum may have the points (the vertices of the polygons) of its structure superimposed in infinite spatial positions, thus generating an infinite geometric density in each particular dimension within Absolute Empty Space, here called the Omega Dimension. If we draw an analogy between the structure of a Geometric Continuum and that of a simple form, such as a cuboctahedron stationary in space, as merely a "cell," a static drawing within the structure of the Geometric Continuum (GC), we may comprehend what a Geometric Hypercontinuum is.

Thus, let us imagine that this cuboctahedron has infinite identical "copies" of itself positioned at infinite points in Absolute Empty Space, all corresponding to the dimension of its "original" and "rotated" about infinite axes, while maintaining the same dimension, at the same time that these infinite "copies" also exist in infinite directions and to infinity, leaving behind them infinite faithful "copies" of their structure, filling all the space between any adopted initial and final position with their infinite "copies." Thus, we may say that these infinite "copies" of the same structure, with a certain arbitrary Structural Dimension, represent a "small" part of the Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG), which is spatially infinite. And that the Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) is, therefore, the summation of the infinite forms of infinite bodies in infinite positions and directions in Absolute Empty Space, forming infinite Apparent Realities of arbitrary base.

In the structure of a single Geometric Hypercontinuum with any Structural Dimension, or in an Apparent Reality of any dimensional base, all bodies — from the Compalphas, through planets, stars, and galaxies, to the structure of the universe as a whole — possess infinite "copies" of themselves, identical or progressively different, located in infinite positions. Thus, these infinite "copies" ensure, for example, that something may be moved from a position A to a position B, and that this something has infinite possibilities of being or of occurring in ways absolutely distinct from itself. It is this characteristic of Geometric Superposition of the Hypercontinuum that enables the universe to make infinite decisions, that enables the bodies, the beings of the universe, to make infinite decisions, that they may have "free will."

In very simple terms, we may say that a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) is merely a Geometric Continuum (GC) of any dimension, revolved about infinite axes of rotation. Note, however, that in the animation of this post, only 6 Structural Dimensions of superimposed Geometric Continuum are shown (but not revolved) at only 6 points in Absolute Empty Space.

A plausible graphic representation of a Geometric Hypercontinuum is something absolutely impossible to demonstrate; not even a supercomputer is capable of generating such geometric density. Thus, what we can do is merely show some superpositions or distinct states of its configurations in an attempt to form an idea of this infinitely dense geometric structure.

Presentation 3.8 – Aspect of the Superposition of Geometric Continuums (GC) Forming a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG)

By having infinite geometric density, a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) allows a Compalpha, a Meron, or a molecule — and hence anything formed by them — to have an exact "copy" of itself disposed in infinite positions along any direction of its own structure.

Thus, it is this property of superposition possessed by the Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) — that of allowing any geometric element (the Compalphas) to be "drawn" in infinite positions in space — that generates Apparent Movement in the elements of its structure. It is in the Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) that Apparent Movement comes into existence and, consequently, all forms of energy, since both things — that is, "energy" and Apparent Movement — according to TUIDG, are a single distinction.

The Geometric Ultracontinuum and the Infinite Apparent Universes

What is a Geometric Ultracontinuum and how does it differ from the Geometric Hypercontinuum?

According to the propositions of TUIDG, a Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG) is an immaterial structure constituted by the superposition of infinite Geometric Hypercontinuums (HCG) with infinite distinct Structural Dimensions, whereas a Geometric Hypercontinuum is an immaterial structure constituted by the infinite superposition of the infinite Compalphas of a single Structural Dimension. Thus, the Geometric Ultracontinuum is formed by the superposition of infinite Geometric Hypercontinuums rotated at finite angles and disposed at infinite points of the Absolute Empty and dimensionless Space that is the universe, since there exist infinite Geometric Hypercontinuums (HCG) with infinite Structural Dimensions.

The immaterial structure of a Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG) allows the infinite Apparent Realities (or universes) provided by the Geometric Hypercontinuums to exist in infinite Structural Dimensions, while the immaterial structure of a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG) only allows for the existence of infinite Apparent Realities structured from a single Structural Dimension of Compalphas — an arbitrary dimension relative to any other arbitrary dimension. All of these immaterial structures possess exactly the same basic geometrically indeterminate elements, which are the Compalphas, which are the starting point for the infinite subsequent structures, with infinite proper dimensions within the sole Omega Dimension. Despite the existence of infinite Apparent Realities, of infinite superimposed immaterial universes, the intelligent beings that may exist in any one of them, of any geometric dimension, will only be able to observe directly or indirectly, or even interact in a meaningful way, with only Six Structural Dimensions, which are the Six Coexistent Levels of Structural Organization proposed by TUIDG.

But do these geometric Structural Dimensions have no end? Could there exist other fundamentally different structures beyond the structure of a Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG), or is it the final structure?

In fact, by the logic of possibilities, the Geometric Ultracontinuum is the final structure, for what differentiates one type of Geometric Continuum (GC) from another is not simply the Structural Dimension of its basic elements, which are the Compalphas, but the superposition of its Structural Dimension, of the rotation and of the spatial position of these basic elements. For even though a simple Geometric Continuum (GC) may have any structural dimension, by itself it does not become a Geometric Hypercontinuum (HCG), and what causes a structure to become another structure is the fact that it can be disposed in infinite positions in the Absolute Empty and dimensionless Space that is the universe. That is why no other type of structure can exist, for if for each of the infinite possible geometric Structural Dimensions there already exists a superposition, it makes no sense to speak of other structures.

According to TUIDG, the Apparent Reality of the universe is produced by a hierarchy of dimensionless immaterial geometric elements that first form the Geometric Continuums (GC), which in turn form the Geometric Hypercontinuums (HCG), which finally form the Geometric Ultracontinuum (UCG).
